email_subject: Application - Video Content Creator Internship (TikTok Focus)
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Video Content Creator Internship (TikTok Focus) at The Skateroom. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in content creation, SEO, and web design, I am excited about the opportunity to bring my storytelling skills to your mission-driven brand.

In my current role at Episto, I create keyword-targeted content and manage WordPress sites, which has sharpened my eye for engaging digital experiences. On my own project, mirook.com, I've designed and built a full website, integrating social media and implementing structured data to boost visibility. I am a TikTok native who understands trends and what makes content scroll-stopping. I am comfortable shooting and editing on my phone using tools like CapCut, and I am eager to collaborate with your Comms Director to develop concepts that resonate with your audience.

I am passionate about art, skate culture, and creative storytelling, and I would love to contribute to your impactful projects. I am available for a full-time internship and can discuss days based on your needs.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can help tell The Skateroom's story.

Best regards,

Baver Ok
